summaryParagraphs: This PR adds Documents Room frontend agent guidance. It introduces a dedicated skill, a testing playbook, and local AGENTS.md guidance under the Documents Room page area, plus an INVARIANTS.md file documenting important behavioral constraints.

The PR is designed to reduce accidental regressions in a complex frontend surface by giving agents explicit domain context, testing expectations, and invariants. It is fully documentation-based and touches only four files.

findings.title: This file is mentioned many times, I guess it's an important one. Yet I'd like to claim that that...
findings.text:
This file is mentioned many times, I guess it's an important one. Yet I'd like to claim that that duplication might bite us eventually:

1. Hard to correlate cause and effect - when some instructions won't be respected, it would be hard to realize why and how to improve
2. Harder to change - Changing in one place may drift in other places
3. Token consumption

Instead, mention once, if it won't get activated let's consider techniques to improve

findings.title: Important: it looks like the content documents have no single responsibility, consequently they a...
findings.text:
Important: it looks like the content documents have no single responsibility, consequently they are big and overlapping. Agents.md holds both tech context and also workflows and domain info, invariants is a big pile of instructions which overlap with agents.md. The downside is that every small task will load the entire context, and also updating these docs will be chellenging since they are bulky

Looking at the last 50 real Documents Room changes (in Git), over a quarter (28%) were cross-cutting work (translations, spacing, colors) that needs none of this knowledge. Another fact: 42% of the last 50 commits touched ai suggestions only - which is why it earns its own dedicated reference doc rather than being bundled with other domain knowledge

We may consider breaking the knowledge into a few small, topic-focused docs and load only the one a task needs, For example (just one idea, critique it):

```
apps/frontend/frost/src/pages/platform/documents/
└── AGENTS.md                          # slim orientation: purpose, mental model, architecture, key files, run cmd

.cursor/skills/documents-room-frontend/
├── SKILL.md                           # router: baseline + "if you're doing X, load Y"
└── references/
    ├── invariants.md                  # the hard rules (cheap always-on baseline)
    ├── associations-and-folders.md    # associations, folders, filters
    ├── actions-and-permissions.md     # visibility, bulk actions, permissions, auditability
    ├── ai-suggestions.md              # AI suggestion lifecycle, match states, reconciler
    ├── testing-playbook.md            # which test file to extend, helpers, mocks
    └── checklists.md                  # change checklist + PR-description checklist
```
